# External references

Nothing here is required at runtime by the plugin itself. These are the off-site
tools/URLs the project links to or depends on for assets.

## Asset hosts referenced by main.pjs (exampleData)
- https://i.imgur.com/1spyUp1.png   ...and 10 more — see MANIFEST.md section 4.
  All 11 archived under assets/example-layers/. (Imgur has begun deleting old
  uploads, which is why the docs page recommends migrating.)

## Recommended upload hosts referenced by index.html
- https://perchance.org/upload — Perchance's own file upload
- https://catbox.moe — free permanent file host

## Tools referenced by index.html
- https://photopea.com — browser-based image editor

## Platform runtime
- https://perchance.org — the Perchance engine (evaluates main.pjs, injects index.html).
  No other runtime is needed.
